name: bounded-module-size
body: Every first-party production source file of the apg root crate stays within a small line budget (roughly 400 lines), so a reader can hold one module in mind. Test code is accounted separately: a module's unit/int tests live in a sibling `tests.rs` and do not count against the production budget, and the top-level e2e test crates are not production source. The budget is a design bound checked by enumerating first-party source files and their line counts, not a runtime behaviour.
